Adds Keep Full and Keep Empty buttons to: Adds Keep Full and Keep Empty buttons to storage buildings. Keep Full continuously fills the storage. Keep Empty continuously drains it. Requires returning to main menu and reloading save to take effect.
Adds a constant amount of MW to the glob: Adds a constant amount of MW to the global electricity pool every tick. Set to 0 to disable. Range 0-10000 MW.
Adds a constant amount of TFLOPS to the: Adds a constant amount of TFLOPS to the global computing pool every tick. Set to 0 to disable. Range 0-10000 TFLOPS.
Advances every repeatable research node: Advances every repeatable research node by one count, but only those whose prerequisites are already met. Click again to advance them further.
Buildings, vehicles and upgrades complet: Buildings, vehicles and upgrades complete instantly with no construction materials required. Same as sandbox mode's instant construction.
Ctrl+Left Click to instantly fill any bu: Ctrl+Left Click to instantly fill any buffer. Ctrl+Right Click to empty it.
Disables all maintenance usage for build: Disables all maintenance usage for buildings, vehicles and everything else.
Disables all pollution penalties: air, w: Disables all pollution penalties: air, water, landfill, and radiation. The settlement is unaffected even if you produce pollution.
Drains a constant amount of MW from the: Drains a constant amount of MW from the real grid every tick — useful for stress-testing your power network. Set to 0 to disable. Range 0-10000 MW.
Fake computing load set to {0} TFLOPS: Fake computing load set to {0} TFLOPS
Fake power load set to {0} MW: Fake power load set to {0} MW
Fill tool ON — Click/drag on designation: Fill tool ON — Click/drag on designations to fill with {0}
Hold this modifier and click a storage t: Hold this modifier and click a storage to instantly fill or empty it.
Instantly complete the currently active: Instantly complete the currently active research.
Instantly removes all trees marked for h: Instantly removes all trees marked for harvesting.
Instantly repairs the docked ship to ful: Instantly repairs the docked ship to full health.

Invalid TFLOPS value! Must be 0 or more.

Invalid population! Must be 0 or more.

Keeps Unity full at all times, thanks to: Keeps Unity full at all times, thanks to YouTuber "Whatchamacallit Gaming" being annoyed to manually refill it so now it's here ;)
Moves all cargo from the docked ship int: Moves all cargo from the docked ship into shipyard storage.
Oil on the map never depletes (not world: Oil on the map never depletes (not world map/oil rigs).
Only needed for WorldGen++ versions belo: Only needed for WorldGen++ versions below v1.0.3 — fixes a bug where some maps don't place the Radar 2, Corn, Sugar cane or Poppy seeds unlock on the world map. Click to unlock all four. Not needed on newer WorldGen++ versions.
Open or close the Mori++ Overlord window: Open or close the Mori++ Overlord window.
Open or close the fill tool. Pick a prod: Open or close the fill tool. Pick a product in the menu first.
Pick a cargo wagon type and set its capa: Pick a cargo wagon type and set its capacity. Leave blank to keep the default. Per-save.
Pick a cargo wagon, then type a new capa: Pick a cargo wagon, then type a new capacity. Leave it blank to use the default.
Pick a vehicle and type new values. Leav: Pick a vehicle and type new values. Leave a field blank to keep the default. Per-save.
Pick a vehicle, then type new values. Le: Pick a vehicle, then type new values. Leave a field blank to use the default.
Place dig designation to remove land or: Place dig designation to remove land or dump to add selected resource from the list.
Radar 1, Radar 2, Corn, Sugar cane and P: Radar 1, Radar 2, Corn, Sugar cane and Poppy unlocked!
Reduces the Fake Computing Output budget: Reduces the Fake Computing Output budget by this amount each tick. To simulate load above your real grid, raise Fake Computing Output then set this to the desired drain. Range 0-10000 TFLOPS.
Remove all trees selected for harvesting: Remove all trees selected for harvesting
Research nodes unlock without their pare: Research nodes unlock without their parent technologies being researched first — pick and research anything in the tree directly. Research Unity and science costs are unaffected.
Research that normally requires accumula: Research that normally requires accumulating a quantity of a product (e.g. 200 spent fuel rods) unlocks without it. Research Unity and science costs are unaffected.
Reveal all locations on the world map.
Set the Unity points cap or refill to ma: Set the Unity points cap or refill to maximum.
Set the exact population count for your: Set the exact population count for your island.
Set the maximum amount of items the ship: Set the maximum amount of items the shipyard can store.
Set the maximum number of vehicles you c: Set the maximum number of vehicles you can own.
Settlement won't accumulate biowaste (bi: Settlement won't accumulate biowaste (biomass). No biowaste product is generated from housing.
Settlement won't accumulate waste (landf: Settlement won't accumulate waste (landfill). No waste product is generated from housing.
Show floating arrow icons above storages: Show floating arrow icons above storages that have Keep Full (green up) or Keep Empty (red down) active. Disable to hide the icons.
Show floating arrow icons above storages that have Keep Full (green up) or Keep Empty (red down) active. Disable to hide the icons. Icon size can be changed via Tweaks++ → Overlays → KE/KF Icon Size.
Temporary fix for a WorldGen++ bug where: Temporary fix for a WorldGen++ bug where some saves don't get the Radar 2 unlock placed on the world map. Use this until the bug is fixed.
This is turned off because of conflict w: This is turned off because of conflict with PlaceResourceMod. I will let his mod handle it instead if you want best of both worlds =)
Transfers shipyard cargo into matching b: Transfers shipyard cargo into matching base storages, sorted by import priority. Does not auto-assign products or destroy anything.
Turn allowing pipes to go underground on: Turn allowing pipes to go underground on or off.
Turn building pipes along slopes on or o: Turn building pipes along slopes on or off.
Turn bulldozing of underground pipes on: Turn bulldozing of underground pipes on or off.
Turn the underground pipe depth labels o: Turn the underground pipe depth labels on or off.
Unlocks all research whose prerequisites: Unlocks all research whose prerequisites are already met. Techs locked behind unmet criteria are skipped. Does not touch repeatable research.
Unlocks every research node regardless o: Unlocks every research node regardless of criteria or prerequisites, in multiple passes until nothing remains. Does not touch repeatable research.
Vehicles and generators won't consume an: Vehicles and generators won't consume any fuel.
Warning: Permanently destroys all cargo: Warning: Permanently destroys all cargo stored in the shipyard.
Water facilities won't produce wastewate: Water facilities won't produce wastewater output. The building still works and satisfies housing water needs.
When OFF, the area-delete tool will skip: When OFF, the area-delete tool will skip pipes that sit below the terrain surface, protecting them from accidental bulldozing. When ON, area-delete behaves normally and includes underground pipes.
When ON, a small number floats above eac: When ON, a small number floats above each buried pipe end while you are placing pipes, showing how many tiles deep below the surface it sits. Turn off to hide these depth numbers.
When ON, pipes can be built below the te: When ON, pipes can be built below the terrain surface. Press Down while placing a pipe to lower it past ground level. Only affects pipes.
When ON, pipes follow sloped ground and: When ON, pipes follow sloped ground and ramp up and down hills instead of staying flat, so you can run a pipe straight down a hillside. Only affects pipes.
